games.title: Courier Chaos
games.description: Time is money, and you are the fastest, most reckless delivery driver in the metropolis. Memorize complex city layouts, hit ramps to jump over gridlocked traffic, and deliver suspicious packages before the timer hits zero—all while avoiding the local authorities.

games.title: Warthammer 40k + 1: The Battle for the Golden Hygiene
games.description: The Emperor has been constipated for ten millennia. You lead the 'Janitorum Guard,' an elite force dedicated to securing the legendary 'Golden Plunger' from the clutches of the 'Dysentery Demons' and the 'Orks Who Just Want a Good Flush.' It’s a messy, grimdark war, but someone has to clean it up.

games.title: Hollow Quest
games.description: A haunting action-RPG set in a world where time has shattered into overlapping eras. Shift between past and future versions of every location, manipulating history to forge a new present. Features 60+ hours of non-linear storytelling.

games.title: Transit
games.description: Cater to the elite in the world of high-end, bespoke transport. Take the wheel of ultra-luxury coaches engineered for VIP clients. You must focus on maintaining a buttery-smooth ride, utilizing advanced performance tuning for your suspension and engine, and customizing the cabin with lavish interiors to ensure five-star reviews from high-paying passengers.

games.title: Banquet of Crowns
games.description: As the personal chef to a politically vulnerable monarch, your menu choices dictate the fate of the realm. Prepare extravagant, multi-course feasts for visiting dignitaries, navigating a complex web of cultural taboos, dietary restrictions, and assassination attempts. One misplaced drop of nightshade or an undercooked swan could spark an all-out war.

games.title: Messenger
games.description: Act as the chief communications architect for an expanding empire. You must design a flawless pigeon-based messaging framework. Establish modular routing nodes in high towers, assign highly descriptive, unambiguous tags to message cylinders, and prevent infinite loops where confused birds deliver the same declaration of war back and forth until they drop from exhaustion..

games.title: Prime Directive: Optimize
games.description: As an industrial labor unit dropped onto a resource-rich exoplanet, your job is to build a massive, perfectly optimized extraction facility. Construct sprawling conveyor belts and complex smelting nodes.
